actual.descripcion: A down on his luck drifter is offered a dangerous, but profitable job.

siguiente.descripcion: Frontier tale about an impassive, out-of-town marshal's encounter with the hostile community of Sabbath. When he chases a group of wanted men into the town, the lawman finds that the local sheriff and much of the populace are in the pay of a criminal rancher, and he soon finds himself confronting difficult opposition as he tries to carry out his business.

Jamie's crew struggles with undersized equipment while overhead power lines threaten. A new driver learns the ropes though a mishap or two and turns up missing when the weather turns.

PC Niaz Waddington is trying to keep a low profile in an unmarked car as he attempts to catch up to a vehicle on cloned plates on the M56. Meanwhile, in Chester, PC Amy Hollis is responding to a live lane breakdown on a busy dual carriageway.

Interceptor Martin clocks a driver smashing the speed limit at more than 100mph. Soon banged to rights in the back of the cop car, the driver gets lippy, and his attitude lands him in even more trouble.

When his girlfriend is taken away, a drunk driver shows his true colours by propositioning Interceptor Sophie in the back of the cop car. An Astra van leads the interceptors on a breathless, night-time pursuit with devastating consequences.

PC Ian Cosgrove tries to pull over a suspected drink driver refusing to stop. Meanwhile, in Warrington, PC Chris Swash is blue-lighting to a collision involving multiple vehicles. As he makes his way to the location, another collision takes place.

Coups the dog handler takes Rambo in search of a gang who've been slashing lorry curtains to steal the goods inside, then joins cops from Derbyshire and Leicestershire to track a van filled with suspected stolen goods.
